visualCharacteristics: A row of contact boxes showing an eyebrow, a phone number, opening hours and a call-to-action, optionally followed by banner images or a list of links.
contentPattern: Optional heading row (h2, no link); then one row per contact box with eyebrow, tel, hours and link paragraphs; trailing rows hold linked pictures (banners) or a list of links.
usage: Use to present phone contact points with hours and a contact CTA, plus related banners or links.
reuseGuidance: Reuse wherever phone/contact information is shown in boxes; pick columns for generic multi-column content without phone details.
